The distributed runtime is the win64 LGPL shared variant and is kept under its
original FFmpeg filenames. The original LICENSE.txt supplied with the binary
distribution is included beside the executables and DLLs.

Anyone publicly redistributing Deckino.Tools remains responsible for satisfying
the complete FFmpeg LGPL compliance requirements, including making the exact
corresponding source and build information available with the distributed app.
